speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Granulation Tissue Formation (Post-Tympanoplasty)

The shooting pain upon eating and difficulty wearing earrings, combined with your history of chronic ear infections and recent surgery, strongly suggests granulation tissue forming at the surgical site. This tissue is highly vascular and sensitive, often causing referred otalgia when the jaw moves or when earrings press against the healing ear canal. Since the CT scan showed normal bony structures, ruling out cholesteatoma or ossicular erosion, the clinical picture points to soft tissue pathology rather than structural failure. Does the pain persist if you keep your mouth closed and do not touch the ear with an earring?
